pytest-requires-pythonpath-src.fact: Tests must be run from the repo root with PYTHONPATH=src set, because the inventory package lives under src/ and is not importable otherwise (e.g. `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/...`).

make-fixtures-before-tests.fact: Run `make fixtures` before running the test suite; the tests failed with FileNotFoundError until the fixtures target had been run.

project-formatter-is-make-fmt.fact: The project formatter is invoked via `make fmt` (which runs scripts/fmt.py), and CI's style check fails unless src/ has been formatted with it, so run `make fmt` after editing files under src/.

style-test-needs-formatted-src.fact: tests/test_style.py fails with 'src/ is not formatted with the project formatter' whenever src/ has unformatted edits, so run the formatter before running that test.

gen-fixtures-script.fact: Run `python scripts/gen_fixtures.py` before the test suite to generate tests/fixtures/catalog.json; tests failed with FileNotFoundError until this had run.

project-formatter-script.fact: The project formatter is `python scripts/fmt.py`; run it after editing files under src/, since CI's style check fails on unformatted src/.
